decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly diminish the opponent's resources and finish the game swiftly. By combining powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker with removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on. Seasoned Pyromancer provides card advantage and graveyard synergies, while cards like Grief and Thoughtseize disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to out-tempo and out-value the opponent through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Colossus Hammer onto a creature like Ornithopter or Puresteel Paladin to create a massive threat that can deal lethal damage in just a few swings. The deck uses cards like Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for the equipment pieces, as well as Urza's Saga to find the necessary artifacts. Esper Sentinel and Emeria's Call provide additional value and protection to the combo, while cards like Giver of Runes and Solitude help to protect the key pieces from removal spells.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells with Cascade mechanics, allowing you to cast additional spells for free. By chaining together spells with Cascade, you can create a tempo advantage and put pressure on your opponent early in the game. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells to protect your creatures and spells, ensuring that you can maintain control of the game and push through for a win.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to convert non-creature spells into powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The combination of Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for consistent card advantage and disruption. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide additional control elements while Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending offer removal options. The mana base includes a variety of fetch lands and splash colors to support the deck's diverse spell requirements. Overall, the deck aims to creatively assemble combos to overwhelm and outmaneuver opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by countering spells, removing threats, and disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Wrenn and Six to pressure the opponent while maintaining control. The inclusion of the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard provides additional value and flexibility in gameplay. Overall, this deck aims to establish dominance through a combination of control elements and efficient threats in order to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to efficiently disrupt the opponent's hand and board state while applying constant pressure with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to strip away important cards from the opponent's hand, and combining that with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot. Cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional tricks to keep the pressure on, while Lightning Bolt and Terminate give direct removal options. Blood Moon can also disrupt the opponent's mana base, making it harder for them to respond effectively.

The deck focuses on using cheap, efficient creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also includes card draw and selection to maintain pressure and maintain resources. The mana base includes lands that can fix colors and disrupt the opponent's mana, adding another layer to the strategy. The deck aims to control the board while staying aggressive, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by disruptive spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to protect their threats. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to control the board and push through damage. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to smooth out draws and maintain card advantage. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through various powerful cards and abilities. The deck includes a variety of control spells like Prismatic Ending and Leyline Binding, as well as powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. Additionally, the deck features creatures like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Omnath, Locus of Creation to maintain board presence and pressure opponents. The mana base includes a mix of triomes and fetch lands to ensure consistency in casting spells and managing colors effectively.

This deck focuses on casting cheap cascade spells to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Crashing Footfalls. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats and tempo plays. The deck also includes interactive cards like Fury and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of aggression and control elements, this deck aims to pressure the opponent while maintaining a level of control over the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity, Leyline Binding, and creatures like Archon of Cruelty to cheat out powerful creatures onto the battlefield quickly, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Spell Pierce. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds an extra layer of combo potential. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the spells, and cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional utility and card advantage. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and disrupt their ability to respond effectively.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Hardened Scales enchantment to maximize the +1/+1 counters placed on creatures. By taking advantage of modular creatures like Hangarback Walker and Walking Ballista, as well as Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with growing threats. The inclusion of cards like Arcbound Ravager and Ozolith, the Shattered Spire allows for even more flexibility in distributing and transferring counters. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and consistency, while the mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive playstyle.

The deck focuses on creating a powerful combo that allows the player to cheat large creatures onto the battlefield by cycling through their deck. By utilizing cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to cycle through their deck quickly, the player can set up for a game-winning Living End spell that brings all their creatures back from the graveyard. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Grief and Force of Negation to control the opponent's game plan while setting up their combo. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden influx of powerful creatures and control elements.

The deck aims to fill the graveyard with cycling creatures and utilize cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to create a powerful board presence by reanimating them all at once. The key strategy is to control the game early with disruption like Force of Negation and Grief, then combo off with Living End to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also has some flexibility with cards like Brazen Borrower and Subtlety for additional disruption and protection. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly transitioning from disruption to a powerful combo finish to secure victory.

This Merfolk deck focuses on quickly swarming the board with powerful Merfolk creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan using counterspells and removal. With lords like Master of the Pearl Trident and Lord of Atlantis boosting the power and toughness of all Merfolk creatures, combined with evasion abilities like islandwalk and flash, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own board presence. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for instant-speed deployment of creatures, while cards like Subtlety provide additional disruption to the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on generating card advantage by using cheap and efficient spells like Mishra's Bauble, Consider, and Expressive Iteration. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Counterspell and disrupt their mana base with cards like Blood Moon. Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide aggressive early game threats, while Murktide Regent serves as a powerful mid-to-late game finisher. Lightning Bolt, Unholy Heat, and Spell Pierce provide additional removal and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while providing necessary color fixing.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers, removal spells, and versatile creatures to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The strategy revolves around leveraging the flexibility of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. Additionally, powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide pressure and card advantage to close out the game. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the various color requirements of the deck, ensuring consistent access to all spells.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to cast powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck gains additional mana and untap triggers to generate explosive plays. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to further enhance its game plan. Additionally, the deck includes ways to tutor for specific cards like Summoner's Pact and Expedition Map to ensure consistent access to key combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and lands.

The main focus of this deck is to rapidly deploy artifacts onto the battlefield and generate card advantage through effects like Esper Sentinel, Thought Monitor, and Thoughtcast. The deck utilizes cards like Urza, Lord High Artificer and Ingenious Smith to generate mana and cheat out powerful artifacts. It also features disruptive elements like Metallic Rebuke and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the opponent's plays. With a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful artifacts, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently in order to secure a victory.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Underworld Breach combo to loop through spells and win through generating infinite mana or storm count with Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch. Jegantha, the Wellspring acts as a companion to provide extra mana sources. The deck utilizes artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber for additional synergies and card advantage, alongside interactive spells like Unholy Heat and Teferi, Time Raveler for disruption. Urza's Saga is a flexible tool to find combo pieces and Engineered Explosives can clear the board if needed.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game using a combination of counterspells, removal, and disruption, while ramping up mana to eventually cast Scapeshift and win the game by sacrificing lands to search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and mountains to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck also aims to synergize with cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate additional value and advantage. Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional disruption and protection, while Bring to Light allows for versatile spell selection.
